PNC Bank Inks 4K-SF Retail Lease at 312 West 43rd Street: Residents at the Ellery , a mixed-use residential development in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood, are getting another retailer at the base of their 33-story home. PNC Bank has signed a 3,500-square-foot retail lease at the base of the property at 312 West 43rd Street , according to co-developers and co-owners.

Gravity Fitness Signs 23K-SF Lease at Queens’ Flushing Plaza: An athletic club is following a gravitational pull leading it to eastern Queens. Gravity Fitness signed a long-term, 23,000-square-foot lease at Muss Development ’s Flushing Plaza at 41-61 Kissena Boulevard , where it will occupy the ground floor of a two-story office and retail complex in Downtown Flushing, according.

TJ Maxx Signs 29K-SF Deal to Replace H&M at 150 East 86th Street: Discount department store T.J. Maxx is replacing H&M in a busy retail spread on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned.

Bath & Body Works to Open 9K-SF Store in Flatiron District: Bath & Body Works is opening a new store in Manhattan’s Flatiron District. The soap and scented lotion purveyor has signed a lease to take over the entire nearly 9,000-square-foot retail portion of 129 Fifth Avenue , according to a source with knowledge of the deal.

Retail Vacancy Falls to 4.3% as Q3 Absorption Hits 10.5M SF: National retail vacancy fell 10 basis points to 4.3% in Q3, while shopping center vacancy slipped to 5.4% and mall vacancy dropped 30 basis points to 8.2%. items.summary: An athletic club is following a gravitational pull leading it to eastern Queens. items.headline: Hines Says Retail Recovery Is an Income and Scarcity Call
items.summary: Hines Research says retail pricing has recovered across open-air centers and enclosed malls in the U.S. and Europe, while lagging Asian markets could offer opportunity. About 480M SF of U.S. retail has been demolished since 2000 and development has been slow for over a decade, which Hines calls an underappreciated supply story. Hines frames the opportunity as an income and scarcity call, with returns driven by leasing and execution, and grocery anchors worth about 25% above-market rents in Atlanta.…

items.headline: Mark IV Breaks Ground on 41,500 SF Round Rock Retail Plaza
items.summary: Mark IV Capital broke ground in October on a 41,521 SF plaza at The District in Round Rock, with six single-story buildings and room for nine to 14 restaurant and lifestyle tenants. The plaza is the project’s second vertical phase and is due in 2028, alongside the 316-unit Origin apartments that began construction in March with $86M in funding.…

items.headline: Retail Vacancy Falls to 4.3% as Q3 Absorption Hits 10.5M SF
items.summary: National retail vacancy fell 10 basis points to 4.3% in Q3, while shopping center vacancy slipped to 5.4% and mall vacancy dropped 30 basis points to 8.2%. Leasing totaled 38.4M SF and net absorption hit 10.5M SF, led by general retail at 5.4M SF, with shopping centers at 3.0M SF and malls at 1.9M SF. Elevated construction and financing costs keep supply tight, with 58.1M SF under construction, and Colliers expects limited development to support measured rent growth through 2026.…

items.headline: TJ Maxx Signs 29K-SF Deal to Replace H&M at 150 East 86th Street
items.summary: Discount department store T.J. Maxx is replacing H&M in a busy retail spread on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned. T.J. Maxx has signed a lease for 28,837 square feet at Extell Development ’s retail condominium unit at 150 East 86th Street , according to a source close to the deal and a third-quarter Manhattan retail report from CBRE .…

items.headline: Record Diesel Prices Squeeze Retail Development Pipeline
items.summary: Diesel averaged $6.38 per gallon on Sept. 28, up from about $3.81 in late February, adding to construction and supply-chain costs for retail developers and retailers. Just over 60M SF of retail is under construction, 4% above the all-time low CoStar has recorded, while JLL put Q2 vacancy at 4.4% and net absorption at 10.2M SF. Retailers such as Aldi, Burlington, TJ Maxx and Dollar Tree plan large store expansions, but flat rents and rising costs mean limited new supply to absorb them.…

items.headline: Bath & Body Works to Open 9K-SF Store in Flatiron District
items.summary: Bath & Body Works is opening a new store in Manhattan’s Flatiron District. The soap and scented lotion purveyor has signed a lease to take over the entire nearly 9,000-square-foot retail portion of 129 Fifth Avenue , according to a source with knowledge of the deal. Bath & Body Works will move into the two-level retail unit, owned by Acadia Realty Trust , in the fall of 2027, according to Crain’s New York Business , which first reported the lease.…

items.headline: Manhattan Retail Availability Hits Record Low as Banks Expand
items.summary: Average availability across Manhattan’s prime retail corridors dropped to 11.4% in Q3 2026, the lowest reading since JLL began tracking in 2017, with only 157 spaces left. Bank of America, OceanFirst and Citibank signed leases totaling nearly 35,000 square feet, and JLL says many more bank deals are pending, adding fresh competition for storefronts.…

items.headline: Eyewear Brand Gentle Monster Takes 29K SF at Kushner’s Puck Building
items.summary: A luxury eyewear brand has its sights set on one of SoHo’s most high-profile retail vacancies. South Korean eyewear brand Gentle Monster has inked a 28,500-square-foot deal at the Kushner Companies ’ Puck Building , Commercial Observer has learned. The lease term is more than 10 years, according to a source with knowledge of the deal.…

items.headline: Miami Retail Pipeline Hits 1.3M SF, Highest Since Early 2023
items.summary: Miami-Dade’s retail pipeline reached 1.3M SF in the third quarter, double last year’s level, as developers gain confidence in a market with 3% direct vacancy. Leasing slowed to 257K SF across 118 deals from 413K SF across 150 deals in Q2, and absorption turned negative, yet triple-net asking rents set a record $44.34 per SF. Heavy preleasing is letting developers underwrite new projects, but vacancy below 3% in core submarkets means tenants must stay flexible to find space.…

items.headline: Charter School Inks 56K-SF Lease in Retail Center Near Miami Suburb
items.summary: Charter school network BridgePrep Academy will open another location, this time inside a shopping center in Miami-Dade County. The school operator, which has 19 locations across Florida, signed a 56,000-square-foot lease at the open-air California Club Shopping Center in Ives Estates, near Aventura, 15 miles north of Downtown Miami. The 273,050-square-foot property, owned by RK Centers , sits west of Interstate 95 at 750 Ives Dairy Road .…

items.headline: Three Fashion Tenants Ink Deals at 231 West 39th Street
items.summary: Three women’s apparel brands have taken office and showroom space at 231 West 39th Street in Manhattan’s Garment District, landlord broker and building manager Adams & Company announced Wednesday. Rino & Pelle , a Netherlands-based women’s fashion and accessories brand, has inked a 3,332-square-foot lease at the 12-story building, while luxury women’s wear and fine jewelry brand Valentina Kova took 1,594 square feet, and ready-to-wear resort attire retailer Sister NY scooped up 900 square feet at the…

items.headline: Japanese Restaurant Udon Shin to Open First NYC Spot at 37 West 17th Street
items.summary: Udon Shin , a popular Japanese restaurant with only two other U.S. locations, is gearing up to open its first New York City eatery, Commercial Observer has learned. Udon Shin has signed a 10-year, 2,500-square-foot lease at 37 West 17th Street in Manhattan’s Flatiron District, according to tenant broker Aaron Gavios of Gavios Realty Group . Asking rent was $30,000 per month for the space previously occupied by now-closed Italian restaurant Basta Pasta.…

items.headline: Sports Retailer Lids to Open New Shop Inside Penn Station
items.summary: Sports apparel retailer Lids is adding another location in New York City, this time inside Midtown’s bustling Pennsylvania Station , Commercial Observer has learned. Lids, which sells sports hats, jerseys and fan apparel, has inked a 10-year, 1,993-square-foot lease for a flagship location inside the Vornado Realty Trust -managed transit hub. Lids is the largest licensed sports-minded retailer in North America, with more than 1,300 stores, according to tenant broker JLL .…

items.headline: Italian Restaurant Casa Serra to Open at 227 Front Street in South Street Seaport
items.summary: Lower Manhattan’s South Street Seaport will be living la dolce vita with its latest restaurant lease. Casa Serra , a sister restaurant to East Village eatery House of Pasta , has inked a 2,824-square-foot lease at the Durst Organization ’s 227 Front Street , the landlord announced Tuesday. The 15-year lease has an asking rent of $100 per square foot.…

items.headline: Union Investment Sells Meatpacking District Retail Condo for $27M
items.summary: A high-profile retail space in Manhattan’s Meatpacking District has traded. Union Investment Real Estate , a Germany-based real estate investment manager, sold a retail condo unit at the base of the mixed-use 415 West 13th Street for $26.5 million, according to city records made public Wednesday. The buyer of Unit 1N was the LLC West Gotham Re Projects Corporation , with Nicolo Forni as a signatory. Further details about the buyer and Forni were unclear, as the address tied to the LLC was a law firm.…

items.headline: Investment Firm Garnett Station Partners Expands to 35K SF at 450 Park Avenue
items.summary: Garnett Station Partners , a New York-based private equity investment firm and alternative asset manager, is expanding its office footprint in Midtown Manhattan, Commercial Observer has learned. Garnett has signed an 11.5-year lease to expand its footprint by 10,392 square feet on the entire seventh floor of SL Green Realty ’s 450 Park Avenue , where it has been a tenant since 2023, according to a source with knowledge of the deal.…

items.headline: Skin Care Brand FaceGym to Open New Tribeca Location at 110 Reade Street
items.summary: Time to face the music. FaceGym , a skin care brand that describes itself as a “facial fitness” studio, has inked a 10-year, 2,400-square-foot lease for a new Tribeca spot at 110 Reade Street , according to landlord broker Platinum Commercial . Founded in 2014 in London, FaceGym offers customers “facial workouts” and “combines muscle manipulation techniques” to provide lifting and sculpting services without surgery, according to its website.…
